executiveSummary: Guidance is stable: provisional Elevated 47/100, with no supported change to the seven materiality factors or urgent safety/continuity override. Today's county-matched storm outlook refreshes S07. A newly published FDA soy-allergen announcement and August state labor release are contextual verification leads, not Watershed incidents or staffing findings.
baselineNote: Only genuine 17 and 18 September snapshots are available; a two-day series is not a 30/90/365-day trend. Company exposure remains provisional and Cyber / OT remains unassessed.

observations.title: County-matched weather outlook refreshed; guidance stable
observations.finding: NWS retains isolated-storm and localized-flooding potential for McLean, Woodford and Tazewell counties, with some severe-storm potential Saturday, September 19.
observations.causalPath: County-matched storm potential → possible local road or workforce access interruption → dispatch and production continuity. Actual route, utility and site effects remain unverified.
observations.sourceScope: County-level outlook only; not a warning, actual route closure, facility damage or Wisconsin site match.
observations.decision: Refresh S07 evidence vintage and 24-hour expiry; retain seven factors, action, trigger and guidance revision.

observations.title: New FDA publication: undeclared soy in a seasoned snack
observations.finding: FDA published Saratoga's J. HIGGS seasoned-potato-chip soy-allergen announcement. Its header dates the announcement September 16, 2026, while the body states recall initiation September 15, 2025; that inconsistency remains unresolved.
observations.causalPath: Seasoned-snack allergen/label mismatch mechanism → conditional relevance to baked, roasted or popped formulations → label/formula-control verification only if internally applicable.
observations.sourceScope: No Watershed manufacturer, ingredient, customer or supplier connection established. Publication is confirmed; initiation date is not. No company product hold or recall is inferred.
observations.decision: Retain as a verification lead for Quality, not an alert or score increase. Escalate only upon a verified ingredient/lot/product match or an applicable regulator direction.

observations.title: August state labor release adds context, not a company staffing signal
observations.finding: Preliminary seasonally adjusted unemployment was 4.7% in Illinois (July 4.9%) and 3.2% in Wisconsin (July 3.3%). BLS does not identify either monthly rate change as statistically significant. Wisconsin total nonfarm payrolls rose 11,800 (+0.4%).
observations.causalPath: Regional labor-market conditions → possible recruiting competition → conditional staffing/cost exposure; company vacancy, retention and wage evidence absent.
observations.sourceScope: Statewide, all-industry context. Not manufacturing-only, plant headcount or local hiring results. Do not splice August state SA data into July metro NSA benchmarks.
observations.decision: Retain S09 factors and guidance. Await the September 30 August metro release and actual recruitment evidence before changing local staffing judgments.

observations.title: Undated EIA table correction is a source-vintage note, not a new shock
observations.status: Source-quality note; S01 and S13 unchanged
observations.finding: EIA's September outlook carries a correction notice for its distillate-crack-spread table. The correction date is not supplied. Existing S13 uses the qualitative distillate constraint scenario, not the corrected numerical spread.
observations.causalPath: Petroleum/distillate outlook → potential truck-fuel costs → conditional delivered-cost exposure already represented by the shared fuel-cost issue group.
observations.sourceScope: Agency forecast completed September 3, not a realized operational event. Discovery today cannot date the correction.
observations.decision: Record the correction caveat; do not create a new geopolitical event, duplicate the fuel signal, alter factors or resolve a forecast.
